whatThisPluginAdds.text: Agent Bridge connects MCP clients to read-only Capell knowledge and a frozen, draft-only site capability contract over per-user HTTP and explicit-user local stdio, with preview confirmation and redacted audit records.

surfaceOutcome.text: Admins can build scoped prompts and manage a user's client tokens, confirmations, and audit entries. Connected clients can call only the server routes and capabilities enabled for them.

developers.text: Capability providers register typed operations through CapellAgentBridgeCapabilityProvider, and mutating runs pass through preview, confirmation, policy, and audit Actions.

teams.text: Operators can limit an agent to approved capabilities, review a proposed change before execution, and inspect what each client ran.
